Hi Ivan,

Thanks for the call earlier. To get ZagrebTek set up in our procurement system and activate the PO (PO-2026-4432), procurement needs a few items from your side. Can you please send the following as separate attachments or scans: 

- Official VAT registration certificate (PDV / OIB) showing legal name
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached template if easier)
- Banking details (IBAN, SWIFT, account name) and a sample invoice header

A couple of clarifications we need up front so finance/tax can map the PO correctly: 
- Which legal entity should appear on invoices (legal company name exactly as on VAT cert)?
- ZagrebTek VAT ID (formatted as HR###########) — we need this for EU VAT handling.
- Are you supplying services from Croatia to Redwood EU (Redwood Inference Ireland Ltd), or to Redwood Inc (US)? We will invoice the appropriate Redwood entity and tax treatment depends on that.

If ZagrebTek will invoice Redwood Inference Ireland Ltd (our EU purchasing entity), Finance expects B2B VAT treatment under the reverse-charge (invoice without Croatian VAT, buyer accounts for VAT) — but we need to confirm your VAT status and whether you require a fiscal representative for any reason. If you will invoice Redwood Inc (US), different rules apply — likely no EU reverse charge.

If you can send the documents by Wednesday 6 May, we can complete the vendor record and push the PO for signatures. I attached our vendor form to this message for convenience.

Thanks,
Priyom
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
